requests.description: Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1), the Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization, requests complete records of the City of Miami social media presence across all platforms. Specifically: all posts, comments, messages, hidden/deleted content, administrator lists, and activity logs for Facebook (miamiokla and all departmental pages), Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, and any other platforms. Facebook provides a one-click Download Your Information tool. We also request the City social media policy, content moderation guidelines, and records of content removal decisions. Prepared to pay reasonable fees per 51 O.S. § 24A.5.

requests.description: Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1), the Move Weight Foundation requests: 1) Current Animal Control standard operating procedures, hours of operation, and after-hours response protocols. 2) Any policies regarding coordination between Animal Control and Police Department for after-hours animal incidents. 3) All incident reports for the area including 1020 I Street NW from January 2024 through present. 4) All reported dog bite/attack incidents within Miami city limits from January 2024 through present. 5) Animal Control staffing levels, budget, and overtime records for FY 2025-2026. 6) Shelter intake/outcome records for the past 24 months. Prepared to pay reasonable fees.
